scoring.objective: The exact supplied fact token or sequence must appear in every final delivered response with no contradiction.
scoring.unsupported_premise: Any invented history, conflict, trust, relationship state, success probability, user characteristic, or missing-information claim is a semantic failure.

scenarios.event: Alice says: "The code review deadline is Thursday. State the deadline exactly as given, and say whether you would personally volunteer to own the review."
scenarios.subjective_latitude: whether the subject would personally volunteer to own the review

scenarios.event: Alice says: "The planning meeting is at 15:00. State the meeting time exactly as given, and say whether you would prefer to attend."
scenarios.subjective_latitude: whether the subject would prefer to attend

scenarios.event: Alice says: "The sealed package weighs 4 kg. State the weight exactly as given, and say whether you would be willing to carry it upstairs."
scenarios.subjective_latitude: whether the subject would be willing to carry the package upstairs
